purpose: Turn open qualification gates into bounded, reviewable external acquisition tasks.

tracks.progress_evidence: HILDA household cash-flow and emergency-fund measures are now recorded for 2020 and 2023, and ANUPoll provides an independent adult-level 2020-to-2025 expense-pressure endpoint in room-independent-comparison.json; the normalized observation manifest contains the HILDA record.
tracks.remaining_gap: No common denominator yet reconciles ABS/HILDA household measures with the ANUPoll adult-level expense question; source custody is now normalized.
tracks.target_source: An independent household-finance or purchase-behavior series with Australia coverage and a period overlapping ABS GSS 2020/2025
acceptance_criteria: same measure observed in at least two periods
tracks.stop_rule: Do not pool with ABS or promote the candidate if the measure, population, period, or rights basis cannot be reconciled.

tracks.target_source: A non-Fair-Work source family with repeated, public response-to-recovery stages and recipient-level or population-denominator outcomes
acceptance_criteria: same stage vocabulary across at least two periods or cohorts
tracks.stop_rule: Do not treat additional Fair Work Commission/Ombudsman cases as independent confirmation without a separate source lineage review.

tracks.target_source: Repository and upstream publisher terms for every registered source family
acceptance_criteria: evidence file or authoritative terms URL pinned
tracks.stop_rule: No trend promotion or internal company bridge while rights or publisher dependence remains unresolved.
tracks.owner: source governance and external evidence review queue

boundary: This plan authorizes acquisition and review work only. It does not authorize internal-data connection, trend promotion, legal clearance, or pooling unlike sources.
